[NCBK.2.10] **Each fault kind carries a payload, and its cause vocabulary is a
mirror of the wire enum.** `ds_stream_ev`'s union **must** carry one arm per
kind allocated by [NCBK.2.8]. Three of the four lead with a cause, and each
cause **must** be a C enum mirroring the protobuf enum that defines it — same
members, **same values**, per [STYL.5.9.7]:

| Kind | Union arm | Cause enum | Mirrors |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DS_EV_TYPE_ERROR` | `type_error` | *(none)* | `proto/type_error.proto#TypeError` |
| `DS_EV_BOUNDS_ERROR` | `bounds_error` | `ds_cap_name_t` (`DS_CAP_*`) | `proto/bounds_error.proto#CapName` |
| `DS_EV_ENGINE_ERROR` | `engine_error` | `ds_engine_fault_t` (`DS_ENGINE_FAULT_*`) | `proto/engine_fault.proto#EngineFault` |
| `DS_EV_COMPUTATION_ERROR` | `computation_error` | `ds_trap_kind_t` (`DS_TRAP_*`) | `proto/engine_error.proto#TrapKind` |

`clock_ns` and `seq` are on `ds_stream_ev` itself and **must not** be repeated
in an arm; the remaining fields of each protobuf message are the arm's members.

**Same values.** A cause enum carries the proto's `UNSPECIFIED` member at zero
rather than re-basing, and the reconciliation gate compares values, not only
names.

**A cause is an enum and never a bare integer** ([STYL.5.9.7]). Documenting the
values instead of enumerating them removes the compile error a consumer gets
when a member is added, and leaves nothing for the reconciliation to compare —
which is not a lighter registry but no registry.

⚠ **`DS_EV_TYPE_ERROR` and `DS_EV_ENGINE_ERROR` must ship together.** The engine's
ill-typed-operation site splits between them on whether the value came from
`Json` — the artefact-lied half is an `ENGINE_FAULT_ARTEFACT_LIED`
([`proto/engine_fault.proto`]) and the tainted half is a TypeError — so shipping
the TypeError arm alone leaves the other half still emitting nothing while its
sibling emits. A consumer then reads the stream and correctly concludes that no
EngineErrors occurred. That is worse than emitting nothing, because nothing is
legible as nothing and a half-populated vocabulary is not.

`DS_EV_COMPUTATION_ERROR` and `DS_EV_BOUNDS_ERROR` have no such partner.
`ds_cap_name_t` mirrors `CapName`, whose membership is [RTCT.7.1]'s cap table.
